name: Hariste
description: Magus of House Tytalus who wrote the polemic On Alliance with the Offspring, arguing for admitting the Order Miscellanea to the Order of Hermes.

name: Pralix
description: Maga who renounced her House and the Order to head the Order Miscellanea; Trianoma argued she deserved status equivalent to a Founder.

name: Trianoma
description: Early Hermetic figure who supported Hariste and wrote The Journey not yet Complete in favor of readmitting Pralix and the Order Miscellanea.

name: Conciatta
description: Maga of House Bonisagus who expanded Hermetic understanding across the four realms; author of The Application of Vim to the Supernatural Humors, whose lost research may reduce aura penalties including the Dominion.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder of House Bonisagus, remembered for unifying disparate magical traditions into the Order.

name: Robert de Charteris
description: Example magus who writes a polemic, sponsored by Protinus of Verditius, on the benefits of his Tribunal integrating with mundane society.

name: Protinus Velox of Verditius
description: Somewhat selfless Verditius magus, scribe and bookbinder, who secretly sells enchanted books to mundanes and supports loosening restrictions on interaction with society; his blood was turned to ink by Twilight.

name: Austerius Trianomae
description: Elderly Bonisagus politician and scholar of the Code, one of the Trianomae, who ruthlessly opposes integrating the Order with mundane society and is close to Final Twilight.

name: Abacus
description: The last apprentice of Austerius, seventy years old, who has the Tormenting Master Flaw and is eager to show his master up as a senile fool.

name: Bishop of Speyer
description: Bishop who in 1084 granted land and rights to the Jewish community in exchange for annual rent.

name: Pope Calixtus II
description: Pope who signed the Concordat of Worms with Emperor Henry V in 1122.

name: Henry V
description: Holy Roman Emperor bound by the Concordat of Worms with Pope Calixtus II.

name: King John of England
description: King who signed Magna Carta with his nobles in 1215; later released from its obligations by Pope Innocent III.

name: Pope Innocent III
description: Pope who released King John from the obligations of Magna Carta.

name: King Henry III of England
description: King of England who grants the university in Cambridge the right to discipline its own members.

name: Pope Honorius III
description: Pope who issued a bull forbidding the study of civil law in Paris to promote theology.

name: Walter Van den Zande
description: Noted Franciscan scholar who asks magi to accompany him on a voyage to the Magic realm using notes found in Paris.

name: Joseph of Napoli
description: Figure described in Antagonists whose chapter provides material for magi seeking to work with the Church.

name: Viea
description: Figure whose final end accompanies the fall of Amazonia in a story seed where Amazons join House Flambeau.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House of Hariste; in a story seed it absorbs the Augustan Brotherhood and moves its domus magna to the Rhine Tribunal.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House of theoreticians and politicians including Conciatta and Austerius; holds the right to take apprentices from other magi.

name: House Verditius
description: House of item-enchanting magi, including Protinus, who would benefit from an open market for magical devices.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: House formed when the Order Miscellanea was admitted to the Order of Hermes.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House some of whose members are intent on entering battle; in a story seed the defeated Amazons join it.

name: House Merinita
description: Faerie-focused House whose magi may bring humans and faeries together to enforce binding agreements, and may use the Bloodline target.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House whose magi have spells to create one-way windows in walls; some members oppose the Amazons joining the Order.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House named as an obvious candidate to flout convention and embrace society.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House named as an obvious candidate to flout convention and embrace society.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House that may see opportunities in embracing society to further its own aims.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The organization of Hermetic magi, whose possible transformation into a fourth estate in mundane society is the subject of this chapter.

name: Order Miscellanea
description: Group of traditions led by Pralix that was eventually admitted to the Order of Hermes as House Ex Miscellanea.

name: Trianomae
description: Politically focused branch within House Bonisagus to which Austerius belongs.

name: Augustan Brotherhood
description: Magical organization embedded within the courts of Mythic Europe providing intelligence and service to nobility; could be brought into the Order as a new House.

name: Amazons
description: Warrior sorceresses from Amazonia described in Rival Magic whose tales reach the Order; in a story seed they join House Flambeau.

name: Columbae
description: Group of magi specializing in magic affecting circles and rings, whose help could be valuable in creating a magical island.

name: Gruagachan
description: Hedge tradition able to enforce Geasa, potentially employed to enforce binding agreements.

name: Ba'al Shem
description: Minor magical tradition that often acts as healers to their communities.

name: Folk Witches
description: Minor magical tradition that often acts as healers to their communities.

name: Nightwalkers
description: Hedge tradition protecting the land; in a story seed a pack becomes corrupted by envy.

name: Mongol Horde
description: Force gathering far to the East that will bear down upon Mythic Europe.

name: The Church
description: The Christian Church with its hierarchy of pope, archbishops, bishops and priests, with which the Order might form accommodations.

name: Gilds of the Rhine
description: Political groupings characteristic of the Rhine Tribunal.

name: Phylai
description: Political groupings characteristic of the Theban Tribunal.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal known for its gilds, to which House Tytalus moves its domus magna in a story seed.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose politics are organized around its phylai.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Tribunal with its own cultural divide.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Vis-poor Tribunal whose magi live near cities and whose Peripheral Code helps magi skirt their Oath; an example of integration failing to preserve magic.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose Peripheral Code may permit what neighboring Tribunals deem irresponsible.

name: Tribunal of the Greater Alps
description: Tribunal to the north of the Roman Tribunal with differing Peripheral Code.

name: Durenmar
description: Location holding Trianoma's original manuscript of The Journey not yet Complete.

name: Paris
description: City where Pope Honorius III forbade the study of civil law, and where Walter Van den Zande found notes on the Magic realm.

name: Cambridge
description: University town granted by Henry III the right to discipline its own members.

name: Iberia
description: Peninsula where the reconquista may take a new dynamic with Hermetic involvement.

name: Amazonia
description: Territory of the Amazons whose fall is imagined in a story seed.

name: North Sea
description: Sea in which the magi create their artificial island, home to Sarmatian sea snails and uninhabited rocks.

name: England
description: Kingdom where all land belongs to the King, so magi cannot own land.

name: Island of the Magicians
description: Artificial island in the North Sea created by Creo Terram rituals from a circular stone wall jacketing an earth infill, letting magi found their own country.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica, governed by feudal rights and obligations.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine influence of God's grace prevalent throughout Mythic Europe, which hampers magical powers.

name: Magic Realm
description: Supernatural realm of magic, replete with spirits, which scholars and adventurers seek to explore.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm of faeries into which a noble is lured in a story seed.

name: Infernal
description: The realm of Hell and demons that may offer false powers to a population accustomed to magic.

name: Divine
description: Realm of God; true leprosy is described as a Divine curse.

name: Opening the Tome of the Animal's Mind
description: InAn 25 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: The Gentle Beast
description: ReAn 25 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Cheating the Reaper
description: CrCo 30 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: The Leap of Homecoming
description: ReCo 35 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Converse with Plant and Tree
description: InHe 25 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Lamp Without Flame
description: CrIg 10 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Communication of the Heroes
description: CrMe 55 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Intelligence of the Heroes
description: CrMe 55 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Sight of the Transparent Motive
description: InMe 10 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie
description: InMe 20 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Posing the Silent Question
description: InMe 20 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Peering into the Mortal Mind
description: InMe 30 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Calm the Motion of the Heart
description: PeMe 15 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority
description: ReMe 20 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits
description: InTe 30 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Odor of Lingering Magic
description: InVi 30 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Piercing the Magical Veil
description: InVi 20 spell known by both Austerius and Protinus.

name: The Inexorable Search
description: InCo 20 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: Pilum of Fire
description: CrIg 20 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: Tales of the Ashes
description: InIg 5 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: Ward Against Heat and Flames
description: ReIg 25 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: The Ear for Distant Voices
description: InIm 20 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: Summoning the Distant Image
description: InIm 25 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: The Miner's Keen Eye
description: InTe 20 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: The Crystal Dart
description: Mu(Re)Te 10 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: Scales of the Magical Weight
description: InVi 5 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: Piercing the Faerie Veil
description: InVi 20 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: Gather the Essence of the Beast
description: ReVi 15 spell known by Protinus Velox of Verditius.

name: The Unexpected Blossom
description: ReHe 40 spell that instantly brings a small orchard to blossom regardless of season; can Warp plants unless designed for specific orchards.

name: A Harvest By Morning
description: CrHe 50 spell bringing a group of plants to full maturity overnight, beginning at sundown.

name: A Herd By Morning
description: CrAn 45 spell bringing up to a hundred animals to full maturity over a single night.

name: Sight of the Wolf
description: InAn 33 enchanted effect that detects wolves within an enclosed paddock or sheepcote, triggering secondary effects.

name: The Unerring Slingshot
description: PeAn 58 effect triggered by Sight of the Wolf that strikes dead all wolves within the enclosure.

name: Wolves in Sheeps' Clothing
description: MuAn 48 effect triggered by Sight of the Wolf that gives the sheep in the enclosure the fangs, claws and ferocity of wolves.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Annually cast ritual protecting against magical and faerie threats without Warping its inhabitants; offering it to the influential builds trust.

name: From This Line Descended
description: InCo 30 spell revealing whether the target of an Arcane Connection descends from a given bloodline and how strong that blood is.

name: Divining the True Heir
description: InCo 20 spell revealing the relationships of a group of claimants to a target bloodline.

name: Summoning the Ancestor Spirit
description: ReCo 45 ritual summoning a magical spirit of a bloodline into a warding circle to be questioned about the true heir.

name: The Impassable River
description: ReCo 60 ritual turning a river into a magical boundary that no man, woman or child can cross, used to protect lands from invasion.

name: Deny Them the Bridge
description: ReTe 30 spell that lifts a stone bridge with its foundations clear of the river and sets it elsewhere.

name: The Wizard's Chevauchee
description: PeHe 50 spell laying waste to all living plants the caster can see for around sixty acres, with a cosmetic magical fire.

name: Permanent Wall of Protecting Stone
description: CrTe 20 ritual creating a permanent 100 cubic pace wall of single unmortared stone.

name: Efficient & Permanent Wall of Protecting Stone
description: CrTe 20 ritual creating a permanent stone wall of 10,000 cubic paces, the maximum at no extra cost for a fourth-magnitude ritual.

name: An Expansive & Permanent Wall of Protecting Stone
description: CrTe 30 ritual creating one million cubic paces of stone, enough for a wall nearly 9.5 miles long.

name: The Wedding Ring of Gaea
description: CrTe 35 ritual creating ten million cubic paces of stone as a circular wall about 94.5 miles long.

name: On Alliance with the Offspring
description: Polemic summa on Order of Hermes Lore by Hariste of House Tytalus arguing for admitting the Order Miscellanea.

name: The Application of Vim to the Supernatural Humors
description: Diatribe tractatus on Magic Theory by Conciatta of Bonisagus opposing research of new Arts for each supernatural realm.

name: The Journey not yet Complete
description: Apologia tractatus by Trianoma favoring admitting the Order Miscellanea; the original is at Durenmar.

name: Concordat of Worms
description: Charter signed in 1122 dividing rights between Pope Calixtus II and Emperor Henry V over investiture of bishops.

name: Magna Carta
description: Charter signed by King John and his nobles in 1215 to limit royal power and restore feudal rights.

name: Protinus's Enchanted Tome
description: Great enchanted tome carrying most of Protinus' spell effects; he also sells enchanted 'spell books' to mundanes.

name: Sarmatian Sea Snail
description: Pony-sized magical snails of the North Sea that eat magical stone and fight in swarms; Magic Might 7 (Aquam).

name: Hippogriff
description: Magical beast persuaded to nest in a waning Magic aura to anchor it.

name: Dragon
description: Beasts whose eggs a noble finds in magical woodland; a small dragon also eats a knight's cattle.

name: Faerie
description: Supernatural beings with powers such as Binding Oath, appearing in several story seeds.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings who may grant false powers and corrupt sorcerers.

name: Angel
description: Divine being that might come to test a bishop.

name: Elemental
description: Being that may form when matter reaches a Warping Score of 5.

name: Spirit of Blood
description: Magical spirit representing a bloodline, summonable through Corpus to identify the true heir.

name: The Gift
description: Supernatural talent for magic whose social effects cannot be underestimated.

name: Hermetic Magus
description: Virtue marking a character as a magus of the Order.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Virtue of Austerius mitigating the social effects of The Gift.

name: Book Learner
description: Virtue possessed by Austerius.

name: Famous
description: Virtue possessed by Austerius.

name: Good Teacher
description: Virtue that adds +3 to the Quality of Austerius' written works.

name: Hermetic Prestige
description: Virtue possessed by Austerius.

name: Puissant Intrigue
description: House Virtue of Austerius boosting Intrigue.

name: Quiet Magic
description: Virtue possessed by Austerius.

name: Subtle Magic
description: Virtue possessed by Austerius.

name: Reserves of Presence
description: New Virtue allowing a character once per day to add +3 to Presence for a scene at the cost of two fatigue rolls.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Standard Minor Virtue on which Reserves of Presence is modeled.

name: Major Magical Focus
description: Virtue; Protinus has a Major Magical Focus in Books.

name: Affinity with Magic Theory
description: Virtue possessed by Protinus.

name: Personal Vis Source
description: Virtue giving Protinus a secret supply of Vim vis.

name: Puissant Magic Theory
description: Virtue possessed by Protinus.

name: Reforging Enchanted Items
description: Verditius Inner Mystery Virtue possessed by Protinus.

name: Skilled Parens
description: Virtue possessed by Protinus.

name: Social Contacts
description: Virtue; Protinus has Social Contacts among magi.

name: Verditius Magic
description: Free House Virtue of House Verditius.

name: Luck
description: Virtue a warped building might gain.

name: Study Bonus
description: Virtue a warped building might gain.

name: Entreat the Powers
description: Learned magician Virtue for overcoming supernatural aura effects.

name: Magic Animal
description: Virtue of the Sarmatian sea snail.

name: Large
description: Quality taken nine times by the Sarmatian sea snail.

name: Difficult Underlings
description: Flaw of Austerius reflecting his relationship with his apprentice Abacus.

name: Enfeebled
description: Flaw of Austerius.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: Flaw of Austerius.

name: Slow Caster
description: Flaw of Austerius.

name: Unpredictable Magic
description: Flaw of Austerius.

name: Weak Characteristics
description: Flaw of Austerius.

name: Dark Secret
description: Flaw of Protinus: frequent sale of enchanted books to mundanes.

name: Magic Addiction
description: Flaw of Protinus.

name: Averse to Risk
description: Flaw Protinus gained as part of Mystery Initiation.

name: Hubris
description: Flaw of Protinus.

name: Limited Magic Resistance
description: Flaw of Protinus (Mentem).

name: Tormenting Master
description: Flaw of Abacus reflecting his relationship with Austerius.

name: Offensive to Animals
description: Flaw a warped building may gain, causing animals to avoid it.

name: Poor Eyesight
description: Flaw a warped building may gain, as a clinging mist.

name: Poor Hearing
description: Flaw a warped building may gain, as a mist that dulls sound.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Ability covering knowledge of the Order; used for polemical texts like On Alliance with the Offspring.

name: Magic Theory

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique (Cr), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique (In), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique (Mu), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique (Pe), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique (Re), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form (An), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form (Aq), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form (Au), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form (Co), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Form (He), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form (Ig), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form (Im), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form (Me), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form (Te), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form (Vi), listed in magi's Arts scores.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The law of the Order; magi may be charged for breaking it, and it also appears as an Ability.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Body of Tribunal rulings interpreting the Code, which differs between Tribunals and governs matters like Wizard War and mundane involvement.

name: Polemic
description: A text arguing to change prevailing wisdom, circulated to generate an Argument Total for debate at Tribunal.

name: Diatribe
description: A text written to oppose a polemic, subtracting its Quality from the Argument Total.

name: Apologia
description: A text supporting a polemic, adding its Quality to the Argument Total.

name: Argument Total
description: Score generated by polemics, apologia and diatribes, spent as experience for debate bonuses or penalties at Tribunal.

name: Prevailing Wisdom
description: The established view a polemic seeks to change, which sets the argument's level.

name: Summa
description: Type of book with a Level and Quality.

name: Tractatus
description: Type of book with a Quality, such as Trianoma's apologia.

name: Fourth Estate
description: The proposed position of the Order of Hermes as a recognized estate of society alongside those who pray, fight and toil.

name: Charter
description: Formal written agreement granting rights and obligations between superior and subordinate signatories, witnessed and sealed.

name: Charter Strength
description: Optional rule scoring each side's legal position in a charter (Intelligence + Civil and Canon Law + stress die).

name: Papal Bull
description: Unilateral charter issued by the Pope on any matter requiring decree.

name: Wizard War
description: Formally declared conflict between magi, requiring a lunar month of notice.

name: Scutage
description: Payment to a liege in lieu of military service, which some Tribunals allow magi to pay in minor enchantments.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural change accumulated by targets under long-term enchantments, leading to Flaws and Virtues.

name: Twilight
description: Magical state; Austerius is perilously close to Final Twilight and magi bear Twilight Scars.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Creo Corpus ritual extending life at the cost of Warping and fertility; can be offered to mundanes.

name: Familiar
description: A bonded magical animal; Protinus' familiar is a large male swan.

name: Talisman
description: Magus' personal enchanted item, which Austerius never created.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power measured in pawns, found at vis sources whose access magi seek to secure by charter.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural influence over an area (Magic, Faerie, Dominion) that magi want protected and which affects spells.

name: Regio
description: Layered supernatural area; a regio level collapses as a Magic aura wanes.

name: Living Conditions Modifier
description: Aging modifier that magic can indirectly improve at +1 per 40 levels of enchantment.

name: Realm-Aligned Spells
description: Hermetic breakthrough allowing spells to ignore the penalty of a detrimental aura.

name: Hermetic Breakthrough
description: Research advancing Hermetic theory, Minor or Major.

name: Holy Magic
description: Magic requiring years of piety, able to overcome the Dominion.

name: Hermetic Leprosy
description: Magically created condition bearing only the symptoms of leprosy, as opposed to true leprosy, a Divine curse.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link to a target, such as a family relic, used for spells like From This Line Descended.

name: Bloodline Target
description: Hermetic target parameter usable by Merinita for inheritance spells.

name: Ritual
description: Hermetic spell requiring vis, with a minimum level of 20.

name: Sigil
description: A magus' personal mark on his magic, which may mar or ornament created walls.

name: Mysteries
description: Secret initiations known to cults that may grant powers like conditional curses or empower companions.

name: Binding Oath
description: Faerie power to enforce oaths.

name: Geasa
description: Obligations enforced by the Gruagachan tradition.

name: Enriched Objects of Virtue
description: Objects enriched using Magic Lore that could spread in Mythic Europe.

name: Schism War
description: Historic Hermetic conflict during which the fire step was probably pioneered.

name: Fire Step
description: Hermetic fortification: raised step behind a solid wall letting defenders cast then take cover.

name: Ablative Slope
description: Slope of mud or sand at the base of a sea wall protecting it from wave erosion.

name: Reconquista
description: Christian reconquest of Iberia that may gain a new dynamic with Hermetic allies.

name: Domus Magna
description: A House's headquarters.

name: Vexillation
description: Secret militant group formed to wipe out the Amazons.

name: Oath of Hermes
description: Oath binding magi of the Order, which grants House Bonisagus special apprentice rights.

name: Magic Might
description: Measure of a magical creature's power.

name: Warding Circle
description: Circle into which a summoned spirit is called.

name: Enchanted Device
description: Magic items given or sold to mundanes, in contrast to ongoing spellcasting services.

name: Tribunal Meeting
description: Gathering of magi where debates occur and charges are heard, every three years.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigator who brings charges under the Code.

name: Praeco
description: Presiding magus of a Tribunal, generally its most senior, whose position is granted by right.

name: Redcap
description: Messenger of the Order; an unGifted redcap may serve as adviser to a bishop.

name: Primus
description: Head of a Hermetic House.

name: Magus
description: Hermetic wizard of the Order.

name: Apprentice
description: Student of a magus.

name: Companion
description: Non-magus character allied with a covenant.

name: Consortes
description: Trusted non-magi who handle a covenant's day-to-day affairs.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Non-Hermetic practitioner who may serve nobles and resent the Order.

name: Learned Magician
description: UnGifted hedge magician tradition able to overcome aura effects.

name: Elementalist
description: UnGifted hedge wizard who might advise those in power.

name: Founder
description: One of the original founders of the Order and its Houses.
